knowledge:
- key_parameters: strata=Character vector defining the clinical trial centers or strata ;; start=Integer vector defining the starting patient ID per stratum ;; stop=Integer vector defining the stopping patient ID per stratum ;; treatments=Named integer vector of treatment allocations and their relative frequencies ;; randomization=List of randomizer descriptions mapped to each stratum ;; seed=Vector of seeds for reproducible trial creation ;; featuresInUse=Covariates used in minimization-based allocation
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: When designing, simulating, or executing clinical trials requiring systematic, reproducible patient allocation to treatment arms across multiple strata using standard or advanced randomization algorithms.
- pitfalls: If strata are defined by multiple combined variables (e.g., sex and center), a custom name mangling scheme is required to map them to the flat strata list. Ensure that the start and stop ranges in PatientID are large enough to accommodate the planned accrual goals.

workflows.name: clinical_trial_randomization
workflows.intent: Define a clinical experiment with specific randomization rules, create a trial instance, and sequentially assign treatments to enrolling patients.
input: patient_covariates.csv (Patient demographic and clinical covariate data used to create PatientData objects)
workflows.stages: 1. Define patient ID ranges per stratum using PatientID ;; 2. Define the clinical experiment using ClinicalExperiment, specifying treatments, factors, strata function, and randomizer descriptions ;; 3. Create the clinical trial instance using createTrial with a seed ;; 4. Create patient data records using PatientData ;; 5. Assign treatments to patients sequentially using getTreatment ;; 6. Retrieve trial enrollment and allocation summary using getEnrolleeInfo
workflows.code:
pIDs = new("PatientID",
           strata = c("Center1", "Center2"),
           start = c(1000L, 2000L),
           stop = c(1150L, 2150L)
)
validPID(pIDs)

trts = c( A = 3L, B = 4L, C = 1L)
pbdesc = new("PermutedBlockDesc", treatments = trts, type="PermutedBlock",
     numBlocks=4L)

CE1 = new("ClinicalExperiment",
   name="My first experiment",
   treatments = trts,
   factors = list( F1 = c("A", "B", "C"), F2 = c("t1", "t2")),
   strataFun = function(pDesc) pDesc@strata,
   randomization = list(Center1= list(pbdesc), Center2=list(pbdesc)),
   patientIDs = pIDs
)

CT1 = createTrial(CE1, seed=c(301, 401))

pD1 = new("PatientData", name="Sally H", date=Sys.Date(),
covariates=list(sex="F", age=33), strata="Center1")
pD2 = new("PatientData", name="Sally Z", date=Sys.Date(),
covariates=list(sex="F", age=34), strata="Center1")

trt1 = getTreatment(CT1, pD1)
trt2 = getTreatment(CT1, pD2)

getEnrolleeInfo(CT1)

trts = c( A = 1L, B= 1L)
bcdesc = new("EfronBiasedCoinDesc", treatments = trts, type="EfronBiasedCoin",
     numPatients=1000L, p=2/3)
CE1@randomization = list(Center1= list(bcdesc), Center2=list(bcdesc))
CT2 = createTrial(CE1, seed=c(301, 401))
btrt1 = getTreatment(CT2, pD1)

urndesc = new("UrnDesc", treatments = trts, type="Urn",
     numPatients=1000L, alpha=1, beta=3)
CE1@randomization = list(Center1= list(urndesc), Center2=list(urndesc))
CT3 = createTrial(CE1, seed=c(301, 401))
utrt1 = getTreatment(CT3, pD1)

md = new("MinimizationDesc", treatments=c(A=1L, B=1L), method=minimizePocSim,
   type="Minimization", featuresInUse="sex")
randomization(CE1) = list(Center1=list(md), Center2 = list(md))
CT4 = createTrial(CE1, seed=c(301,401))
getTreatment(CT4, pD1)
